The keyframe grows from the 20 km Kutai Lama core (1300-1634) to Cliopatria's 28-cell 1648 outline, and no page dates any other gain, so the outline minus the core is attributed to this annexation, plus a 30 km disc round Muara Kaman, which lies partly north of that outline. Region fixed by fx-41 (R048/R063): the gazetteer has neither 'Kutai Lama' nor 'Muara Kaman', so the discs are given by coordinates, the dossier's own capital point for Kutai Lama (117.2 E, 0.55 S, the researcher's approximation) and the kutai-martadipura dossier's capital point for Muara Kaman (116.72 E, 0.2 S); the Kutai Kartanegara Sultanate, Kutai and Muara Kaman pages opened on 2 Nov 2026 give no coordinates.

notes: One state, two Cliopatria rows. 'Kutai Kingdom' (1648-1733) and 'Sultanate of Kutai Kartanegara' (1734-1845) share Wikidata Q1794655, the Wikipedia title 'Kutai' and an identical 6,766 km2 outline; both pages opened describe a single continuous realm, Kutai Kartanegara ing Martadipura. This dossier carries both Names; the se-03-a brief lists sultanate-of-kutai-kartanegara as its own state with the same instruction (one dossier under the earlier slug), so se-03-a should not write a second dossier for it. Life span: Cliopatria begins in 1648; the Sultanate page gives the founding as 1300 at Kutai Lama, so two new keyframes (1300-1634 core, 1635-1647 after the Martapura annexation) are added. Islam: 'In 1575 the kingdom officially converted to Islam' (Sultanate page) but the Kutai page says Aji Muhammad Idris (1732-1739?) was the first ruler with an Islamic name; no ledger type fits, so it is recorded here only. End: Cliopatria runs to 1845; the Kutai page dates the Dutch takeover to 1844 and this dossier ends the state then; the Sultanate page says it continued under Sultan Aji Muhammad Sulaiman (1845-1899) as a Dutch vassal. Counterpart needing a dossier: kutai-martadipura (Kutai Martapura, 'Kutai Martadipura Kingdom (399-1635)', centred at Muara Kaman; Cliopatria lacks it). Gazetteer lacks Kutai Lama, Muara Kaman, Jembayan, Tenggarong. Capital coordinates are approximate (the pages give none). Page tried and not found: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kutai_Kartanegara_Ing_Martadipura. Pages say nothing about Banjar, Gowa/Makassar, Bugis or the VOC, so no vassal or contest events for them are recorded. Revised 2026-10-19 after review (fail, one open finding): the 1635 annexation of Martapura (30 km round Muara Kaman) fell mostly outside every keyframe drawn after it, and the growth from the 20 km Kutai Lama core to Cliopatria's 28-cell 1648 outline had no event. Now K1 and K2-K5 are adjust, each Cliopatria shape plus the Muara Kaman 30 km disc (about 8 cells, 2,000 km2, outside the 1648 outline whose north edge is at about 0.3 S; the pages give no coordinates for Muara Kaman, the position 116.7 E, 0.2 S is the researcher's), and the 1635 gain is the 1648 outline minus the Kutai Lama core plus that disc. The 1844 loss, dissolve, successor land and war zone include the disc too. What is the pages' and what is the reading: both pages date the annexation to 1635 and put Martapura's centre at Muara Kaman; neither gives the extent of either kingdom or says which land Cliopatria's outline covers, so attributing the outline's extra cells to 1635 is the researcher's reading (confidence 2). The two pages differ on the united realm's name: Sultanate page 'Kutai Kartanegara ing Martapura', Kutai page 'Kutai Kartanegara Ing Martadipura'. Pages re-opened 2026-10-19: Kutai Kartanegara Sultanate, Kutai; the Muara Kaman district page was opened for coordinates and prints none.
